purpose: Train and select three direct StructuredPolarMultiDepth seeds to test whether a fixed 180-azimuth by two-radial-depth event field can recover observable junction/terminal geometry that the sealed free-query and single-center baselines miss.

approval.scope: One bounded implementation smoke followed by one immutable three-seed C01-C08 structured-polar capacity run; zero C09/C10/M-TARE, graph or planner access.
approval.confirmation_reference: User instructed automatic best-choice execution without routine approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 five-frame organized 16x720 LiDAR dataset.
Sealed exclusive single-center, free-query joint, frozen-encoder-set and nonlearning geometry development baselines.

worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.temporal_context: Five causal frames per observation; no future frame.
sampling.rule: Each seed visits every C01-C06 observation once per epoch for eight epochs. World order and within-world row order are deterministic per seed and epoch. No row deletion or resampling. Train-only augmentation is one uniformly sampled integer circular shift over the 180 two-degree azimuth bins with the same rotation applied to Teacher xyz.

teacher.source: Observable Teacher V2: native-mesh LOS terminal/junction targets intersected only with the fixed LiDAR vertical field of view.
teacher.slot_assignment: Targets are placed in the nearest fixed two-degree azimuth bin; same-bin targets are assigned depth slot 0 then 1 in ascending 3D radial distance, with identity only as an exact-distance deterministic tie break.
teacher.support: Each target radius is represented as a fraction of the frozen five-frame local free-range envelope; the readiness proof found zero unsupported targets and zero slot overflow.
teacher.valid_mask: event_mask; padding type/identity -1 and zero xyz; all zero-event rows retained.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Deployment receives only robot-relative tokens, descriptor, confidence, uncertainty, azimuth-bin and depth-slot provenance. Teacher identity is supervised-only; graph edges remain execution verified.
teacher.student_input: Only five causal range_m and valid_mask frames.

split.fit: C01-C06 supplies every gradient and event-type class weight.
split.checkpoint_and_threshold_selection: C07-C08 selects the minimum direct dense validation-loss epoch and maximum-F1 confidence from the fixed 0.05:0.05:0.95 grid.
split.historical_pollution_audit: Formal command binds only C01-C08 dataset, Teacher, readiness and sealed development-baseline hashes. Historical C09 values contribute no training, threshold, architecture or result.

model.optimizer: AdamW lr=3e-4 weight_decay=1e-4, gradient norm cap=5
model.presence_loss: Per observation, positive and negative dense slots receive equal total mass when positives exist; zero-event observations use negative-only mean loss.
model.normalization: Fixed physical range divide by 50m inside the model; no fitted normalization statistics.
model.augmentation: Uniform circular roll over 180 integer polar bins, train-only, no tuned magnitude.
model.proposal: Confidence top-16 over all 360 bin-depth candidates, with no neighboring-bin suppression.

acceptance.matching: Same event type and one-to-one 3D error <=4m on all C07-C08 rows.
acceptance.failure_policy: If any seed fails, stop before graph. Preserve the failed checkpoints and attribution evidence; do not tune epochs, loss weights, dense layout, top-k, threshold grid, Teacher, graph or planner.

estimated_cost.smoke_observation: One optimizer step plus 1,004-row validation and serialization completed in 1.70 seconds with 350,733,312 bytes peak CUDA allocation.
estimated_cost.compute: Three sequential deterministic RTX 5090 D trainings.
estimated_cost.gpu: one NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 D, sequential seeds
